findings.issue: GetLatestMetrics adds AND security_id = $1 to WHERE clause
findings.description: Enforces security isolation between companies by scoping metrics to the provided security_id via parametrized query. Prevents cross-company data leakage.
findings.evidence: WHERE as_of = (SELECT max(as_of) FROM derived_metrics WHERE security_id = $1) → AND security_id = $1 AND as_of = (SELECT max(as_of) FROM derived_metrics WHERE security_id = $1)
findings.recommended_action: Verify all callers pass the correct securityID; confirm no other query paths bypass this filter.

findings.description: Validates that GetLatestMetrics correctly scopes metrics to a single security_id. Confirms the data isolation fix (Fix 1) works as intended with cross-company metric sets.
findings.evidence: Test creates securities A and B with separate pe_ratio/roe metrics, calls GetLatestMetrics for each, asserts per-security results.
findings.recommended_action: Run as part of CI to prevent regression of data isolation.

findings.description: Six guards in scoreFundamentals changed from '; ok {' to '; ok && v != nil {' to prevent SIGSEGV/DoS when a metric key exists with a nil value (legitimate NULL metrics). Without this fix, a nil pointer dereference panics the scoring function, enabling local DoS.
findings.evidence: All 6 ratio guards (pe_ratio, pb_ratio, fcf_yield, roe, de_ratio, peg_ratio) updated identically.
findings.recommended_action: Deploy; monitor for any nil-ratio edge cases in production scoring.

findings.description: Verifies that nil metrics are treated as skip (not dereferenced) and that all-nil inputs produce a neutral score of 50. Confirms the nil-guard fix (Fix 3) behaves correctly.
findings.evidence: Two sub-tests: (a) pe_ratio=20.0 with nil fcf_yield/roe/de_ratio → score 75; (b) all six nil → score 50.
findings.recommended_action: Run as part of CI; no code changes needed.

summary: 0 hard blocks. Two security improvements: (1) parametrized query enforces security_id scoping in GetLatestMetrics, preventing cross-company data leakage (medium); (2) nil-pointer guards in scoreFundamentals prevent local SIGSEGV/DoS from NULL metrics (high). No exposed secrets, no secret patterns found in any of the 4 modified files.
